title: The relaxation complexity of the standard simplex is logarithmic
summary: For a set $X$ of integer points, the relaxation complexity $\operatorname{rc}(X)$ is the smallest number of facets of any polyhedron $P$ such that $P \cap \mathbb{Z}^d = X$. In this paper, we focus on the case where $X$ is the discrete standard simplex $Δ_d = \{\mathbf{0}, \mathbf{e}_1, \dots, \mathbf{e}_d\}$. We show that $\operatorname{rc}(Δ_d) = O(\log d)$ by an explicit, elementary construction.
